# `unsigned-reverse-loop`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: correctness · Profile: none · Default: warning · Fixes: quick fix · Options: none

Reports a descending unsigned loop whose condition remains true at zero and
whose update then underflows.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

The loop traps in safe builds or wraps and runs unexpectedly in modes where
overflow is unchecked.

## When it fires

It applies to the common `index >= 0` reverse-loop shape with an unsigned index.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn run(items: []u8) void {
    var i: usize = items.len - 1;
    while (i >= 0) : (i -= 1) {
        items[i] = 0;
    }
}
```
